subject: design/feature-draft
statement: Review each draft contract at a pinned committed head and record the shared PRD and tech-spec digest in its numbered working-file report.
intent: Make the latest PRD and tech-spec reviews verifiably about the version that may lock.
rationale: A read-only CLI prints the compiler-defined digest from committed regular files; both reviewers record it and readiness compares each latest report against the current contract digest.
fit_criterion: Both reviewer reports carry an exact digest; an edit to either contract file makes the earlier review stale, while the prior report remains in the draft history.
